events.continuity_hook: Completes the main San Antonio booking sequence after the hotel hold decision from the block-deadline session.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the remaining Chicago-San Antonio itineraries by fare, carrier, connection risk, Tuesday arrival buffer, airport-to-hotel transfer assumptions, Thursday departure margin, and Chicago arrival time, then identify which flight to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: With the limited-service San Antonio room now held a few blocks from the convening venue, Marisol needs to ticket airfare from Chicago for the January 23-25 arts policy convening. The Tuesday welcome event starts early evening at the cultural center, the Wednesday program remains at the venue, and the Thursday wrap-up is still expected to finish around noon. Current constraints are arriving with enough time to drop bags before the welcome event, avoiding a rental car, returning Thursday after lunch, and keeping the full trip total defensible compared with the official hotel block. The unresolved choice is a better-timed United nonstop pair versus a lower-fare option that adds a connection and gets her back to Chicago later.

events.continuity_hook: Runs the final San Antonio timing check after flights and lodging are in place and the Thursday agenda becomes less certain.
events.interaction_goal: Map the Thursday timeline from the venue to hotel bag pickup and SAT, compare the booked return with the later nonstop, confirm the morning hotel logistics, and decide whether any flight change is needed.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before traveling to San Antonio, the convening organizer adds an optional Thursday funder roundtable that could run until 12:35 p.m., while the booked flight home is in the midafternoon. The hotel confirms early breakfast service, in-room refrigerator availability, and bag storage after checkout. Current constraints are deciding whether to stay for the roundtable, avoiding a rushed rideshare to the airport, carrying only a rollaboard, and not changing flights unless the current margin is truly tight. The remaining question is whether the booked return still works or whether a later nonstop is worth securing while seats remain available.

events.continuity_hook: Begins the next grant-site episode once the January convening travel is mostly settled.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact flight-and-hotel comparison covering BWI versus other airport options, Tuesday arrival timing, Thursday return choices, local transfer assumptions, hotel totals, meeting access, breakfast details, in-room coffee and refrigerator availability, nearby dinner choices, and cancellation terms.
events.scenario_brief: After returning from San Antonio, Marisol starts planning a February 22-24 Baltimore site visit for a library-based arts residency and a neighborhood cultural partner. The draft agenda has a Wednesday 9:00 a.m. meeting near the central library, an afternoon partner visit in Station North, and a Thursday debrief expected to end before noon. Current constraints are flying from Chicago into the most practical airport, avoiding a rental car, staying where dinner and morning coffee are easy, keeping the hotel within nonprofit reimbursement guidance, and returning Thursday after lunch. The main unresolved issue is whether to stay closest to the library at a higher nightly rate or use an Inner Harbor hotel with breakfast and simpler room amenities but slightly more local transit.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Baltimore lodging after the host clarifies the site locations and before airfare is finalized.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the held library-area room against the Inner Harbor alternative by total cost, morning meeting access, afternoon transfer implications, breakfast value, in-room basics, bed setup, dining access, cancellation cutoff, and how each hotel would affect the later flight decision.
events.scenario_brief: The Baltimore host confirms that the Wednesday morning meeting and Thursday debrief will both stay near the central library, but the afternoon partner visit moves farther east and the host can arrange a short rideshare from the morning site. A library-adjacent hotel is on hold, while an Inner Harbor property has dropped in price and includes breakfast. Current constraints are making the 9:00 a.m. meeting easy, keeping two nights within a defensible lodging total, confirming a standard one-bed room with a refrigerator and coffee maker, finding a simple dinner option without a car, and leaving the Thursday flight timing workable. The unresolved choice is whether to keep the more walkable hotel or switch to the cheaper breakfast-included option before the hold expires.
